![Extreme piercings at Phuket vegetarian festival in Thailand ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07260315-1672-0139-0000-c692ec96ac17:4)
The Phuket Vegetarian Festival (also known as the Nine Emperor Gods Festival) is `a spectacular, culturally immersive nine-day Taoist celebration honoring the purification of mind, body, and spirit` . It features dramatic firewalking, self-mortification, and extreme body-piercing rituals performed by devotees called *ma song* (spirit mediums).[](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g297930-d8820427-Reviews-Vegetarian_Festival_Phuket-Patong_Kathu_Phuket.html) [[1]](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g297930-d8820427-Reviews-Vegetarian_Festival_Phuket-Patong_Kathu_Phuket.html)[[2]](https://www.evephuket.com/blog/phuket-vegetarian-festival/)[[3]](https://www.paradoxhotels.com/phuket/lifestyle-blog/phuket-vegetarian-festival-2025)[[4]](https://uk.hotels.com/go/thailand/phuket-vegetarian-festival)

During the festival, you will find hundreds of street food stalls lining the streets surrounding Chinese shrines. They serve an incredible variety of plant-based dishes and are easily identified by bright yellow flags with red Chinese characters.[](https://messyvegancook.com/2025-phuket-vegetarian-festival-planning/) [[1]](https://messyvegancook.com/2025-phuket-vegetarian-festival-planning/)[[2]](https://www.phuket101.net/phuket-vegetarian-festival/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u0DVqahQXDY)

Essential Visitor Guide

- **Dates:** The festival takes place during the ninth lunar month of the Chinese calendar.[](https://www.phuket101.net/phuket-vegetarian-festival/) 
- **Key Locations:** The spiritual center of the event is in Phuket Town, particularly at the **Jui Tui Shrine** and **Bang Neow Shrine** , alongside the historic **Kathu Shrine** in the island's interior.[](https://messyvegancook.com/2025-phuket-vegetarian-festival-planning/) 
- **The 10 Precepts:** Participants strictly adhere to wearing white clothing, abstaining from meat, dairy, alcohol, and sexual activity, and must keep cooking utensils separate from those used for animal products.[](https://www.phuket101.net/phuket-vegetarian-festival/) [[1]](https://www.jamiesphuketblog.com/2016/04/phuket-vegetarian-festival-schedule.html)
- **What to Expect:** Early morning street processions are the highlight for many, but be prepared for incredibly loud firecrackers thrown at the feet of the mediums and dense crowds.[](https://www.phuket101.net/phuket-vegetarian-festival/) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LvEkFuuVhkk&t=28)

Getting Prepared For maps, daily procession routes, and specific event times, check with the **[Tourism Authority of Thailand](https://www.tourismthailand.org/home)** or local tourist information centers once you arrive on the island. If you plan to attend, review the **[Phuket 101 Guide](https://www.phuket101.net/phuket-vegetarian-festival/)** for detailed shrine schedules, cultural etiquette, and photography tips.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u0DVqahQXDY)
